units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 2:2:2">Y. Kil. II, 27ᵈ</cite> top, a. e., v. <cite ref="C01325"><he>גְּרִיד</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 2:3:4">Y. Shebi. II, 33ᵈ</cite> <he>עפר עושה לה ט׳</he> by covering it with earth he prepares for the plant a muddy ground. Y. Kidd. III, end, 65ᵃ (prov). <he>מוליכין ט׳ אצל ט׳ וכ׳</he> mud is carried to mud, and thorns to thorns.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 5">Deut. R. s. 5</cite>, beg.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 938:4">Yalk. Prov. 938</cite> <he>מפני הט׳</he> on account of the moist soil.
<cite ref="Chagigah 15b:13">Ḥag. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>ט׳ היתה בלבם</he> there was impurity in their hearts (heathen sensuality).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 75a:2">Snh. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>העלה לבו ט׳</he> a vehement passion seized him (which threatened his health).
